靳兰玦再怎么虚弱，好歹也是个视力正常，拥有地图的人。

光头似乎只能看到她的身形，但是分辨不了枯树的分布情况。

跌跌撞撞砰了几次树之后，渐渐就落在了后面。

靳兰玦不敢放松，咬牙坚持。

跑到后面，她头晕目眩，大腿酸软得好像下一步落地就要跪倒下去。

她在摔倒的最后一秒，用力歪过身子，避开枯树一头摔进地上的泥潭中。

靳兰玦已经彻底爬不起来了。

她翻身，摊开手脚躺在地上，盯着天空的眼神已经开始呆滞。

树影婆娑，阴沉的天空光线暗淡，张牙舞爪的枯树枝就像交织成片的鬼手，不断向天空抓挠……

靳兰玦身体一僵，慢慢撑坐起来，死死盯着头顶的天空。

准确来说，是头顶的枯树枝。

它们开始像蛇群一样慢慢蠕动。

上一世她就知道，各种诡怪千千万，但是没想到，这些枯树就是诡怪之一。

当真是她见识少了。

现在她还不知道这些鬼怪杀人的条件是什么，刚才只是觉得这些枯树长得恶心，下意识不想碰，没想到误打误撞摸到了其中一个条件。

那么第二个条件是什么？

她还确信自己并没有触碰到这些枯树。

靳兰玦回头看向山下，不知不觉，她已经爬上半山腰，隐隐可以看到山顶微弱的天光。

“啊啊……”

含混的声音伴随着脚步声飞快靠近，靳兰玦侧头看向声音来源，一个瘦小的人影正在慌乱奔跑。

看到靳兰玦的瞬间，那人双眼一亮，立刻朝她冲过来。

嘴里还“啊啊”喊叫着，手舞足蹈不知道想表达什么。

靳兰玦面色大变，扭头就跑。

猥琐小胡子身后，那些枯树枝就像蛇一样蜿蜒生长，一路追着小胡子。

身后小胡子“啊啊”的喊叫声越来越近，靳兰玦虚弱得头晕眼花，甚至腾不开手来给自己撕一包续命架。

【快点啊大师！怪物马上追上你们了！】

【我靠我靠好恶心！大师快跑！】

靳兰玦气得心中大骂。

她能不知道快点跑吗？但是这个身体实在是有心无力啊！！！

No matter how weak Jin Lanjue is, he is still a person with normal eyesight and a map.

The bald head seemed to be able to only see her figure, but could not distinguish the distribution of dead trees.

After stumbling and banging trees a few times, I gradually fell behind.

Jin Lanjue didn't dare to relax and gritted his teeth and persisted.

When she ran to the back, she felt dizzy and her thighs were so sore that she felt like she would fall to her knees in the next step.

At the last second when she fell, she turned her body forcefully, avoiding the dead tree and fell into the mud on the ground.

Jin Lanjue could no longer get up.

She turned over and lay on the ground with her arms and legs spread out, her eyes staring at the sky began to glaze over.

The shadows of the trees are whirling, the gloomy sky is dim, and the dead branches with claws and claws are like intertwined ghost hands, constantly scratching towards the sky...

Jin Lanjue's body stiffened, and he slowly sat up, staring at the sky above his head.

To be precise, the dead branches above my head.

They began to slowly squirm like a swarm of snakes.

In her last life, she knew that there were thousands of weird things, but she didn't expect that these dead trees were one of them.

She really knows very little.

She still doesn't know what the conditions are for these ghosts to kill people. She just thought these dead trees were disgusting and subconsciously didn't want to touch them. Unexpectedly, she accidentally touched one of the conditions.

So what is the second condition?

She also made sure she didn't touch the dead trees.

Jin Lanjue looked back at the bottom of the mountain. Unknowingly, she had climbed halfway up the mountain, and she could faintly see the faint skylight on the top of the mountain.

"Ahh..."

A vague voice approached quickly along with footsteps. Jin Lanjue turned his head to look at the source of the sound. He saw a thin figure running in a panic.

The moment he saw Jin Lanjue, the man's eyes lit up and he immediately rushed towards her.

He was still shouting "Ahhh" and dancing around, not knowing what he wanted to express.

Jin Lanjue's expression changed drastically, he turned around and ran away.

Behind the wretched mustache, those dead branches grew like snakes, chasing the mustache all the way.

The shouts of "Ahhh" from the mustache behind him were getting closer and closer. Jin Lanjue was so weak that he felt dizzy and couldn't even free his hands to tear himself a pack of life-sustaining racks.

[Hurry up, Master!The monster is catching up with you soon!】

[Holy shit, shit, it’s so disgusting!Master, run!】

Jin Lanjue was so angry that he cursed in his heart.

Could she not know how to run quickly?But this body is really powerless!!!
